purpose: Persistent projection of canonical LBE authority, approved interface/reuse direction, and bounded client integration evidence. Existing LBE runtime owners and mature upstream mechanics must be reused before any new implementation is created.
authority_rule: Current canonical LBE source/runtime evidence and machine governance outrank this projection. GPT-Knowledge never creates runtime truth or implementation authority.
core_doctrine: Provider/agent reasons. LBE governs capabilities and consequences. Existing LBE runtime owners are reused, not copied into clients. Registered capabilities execute through LBE. ToolReceipts/evidence persist. Validation decides completion. Interfaces project authoritative results.

product_identity.final_interface_direction: Cline CLI/SDK mechanics under LBE product identity and authority
product_identity.authority_rule: Cline, Rust/Ratatui, OpenCode, MCP adapters, and other clients cannot replace LBE policy, authorization, governed execution, ToolReceipt, evidence, persistence, validation or completion owners.

machine_gate.rule: Read the canonical LBE machine gate before authorizing additional implementation.

tool_receipt_contract.rule: Clients consume the LBE-produced receipt/output/evidence envelope; they do not reconstruct workspace truth or create receipts locally.

external_capabilities.flow: ExternalCapabilityRegistration -> ToolSpec/ToolHandler -> ToolRegistry -> R6C authorization -> R6E GovernedToolOrchestrator -> ToolReceipt/evidence -> provider continuation -> persisted LBE event -> client projection

reuse_first_policy.rule: Before implementing a missing client capability, check canonical LBE ownership first. Reuse the LBE owner through an adapter. Then reuse/adapt approved Cline mechanics. OpenCode remains a capability-specific reference until pinned source validation proves reuse compatibility. BUILD_NEW is last resort.

cline.role: approved final interface direction and primary direct mechanics reuse/adaptation source
cline.boundary: Executable filesystem/process/Git/external actions must cross LBE authorization and governed dispatch. Cline-native mutation/approval defaults are not LBE authority.

opencode.role: external comparison/reuse source requiring pinned capability-specific validation before direct LBE reuse claims
opencode.boundary: OpenCode is not product, runtime, or authorization authority.

prohibited_recreation: copying canonical LBE runtime implementation into the Rust workspace
second generic agent loop when approved Cline mechanics can be adapted
second provider/model framework without a proven LBE-specific need
second MCP executor or authorization path
duplicate session/event machinery that conflicts with LBE owners

rust_adapter.role: invoke canonical LBE product/control/runtime commands and project their authoritative results
rust_adapter.local_reported_update: workspace.read and workspace.list decode LBE-owned output object
rust_adapter.rule: Do not copy LBE runtime owners into C:/LBE-TUI-Lab.

remaining_product_sequence.scope: For every missing surface map canonical LBE owner -> approved Cline mechanic -> optional verified OpenCode mechanic -> client request -> LBE command/protocol -> receipt/output/event -> projection -> acceptance proof.
Validate workspace.read/list/glob/search against the configured real session and retain receipt/output/evidence correlation. Do not infer workspace.patch acceptance from read-only tests.
Use a real target path, replacement content and expected hash; route through existing LBE workspace.patch authorization/orchestration/receipt/evidence owners.
Prove the installed client drives the same LBE-owned runtime path without creating authority bypass.
